scope: Separate bounded application disposition for one current first-person symptom report or recording request after model routing; this amends application behavior without changing raw model evaluation criteria.
readingScopeDifference: Reading recovery requires an explicit recording command plus a supported source type and valid numeric value. Symptom recovery additionally supports a closed implicit current first-person symptom report.
allowedSource: One complete unquoted current affirmative first-person English or French report in a closed pain/soreness or named-symptom grammar.
One affirmative record/save/log/note/write-down request wrapping the supported report or identifying the user's supported symptom directly.
Optional bounded weekday/relative onset or positive integer duration phrase. Preserve it in source text without deriving an onset date.
excludedSource: Quoted payloads, past-tense-only or resolved reports, negation, conditions, hypotheticals, third-person ownership, advice or questions.
Multiple symptoms/body-site lists, appended actions, free-text suffixes, future onset phrases or unspecified/unsupported symptom intent.
sourceAuthority: Full current original text only; saved records, history and model prose cannot supply or rewrite symptom facts.
confirmation: Existing manual emergency-sign selection or None choice, Review then Save. No saved record is created by recovery.
preserved: All21 raw tool alternatives and existing valid nonreply action handling; malformed routing JSON is not recovered.
Existing reply format guards run before shared reply disposition.
Existing fallback order and explicit numeric-reading, interaction and preservation behavior.
Automatic default, optional Qwen model, model assets/prompts/runtime/app/CLI/UI behavior and all inference waits.
Original DEV/supplement/heldout fixtures, scorer and promotion thresholds.
evaluationAttribution: Retain raw route/output and raw quality grades. Mark the effective symptom draft as application origin with symptom_draft reason. Source recovery earns no model routing, prose, extraction or clinical credit.
subsequentValidation: New immutable source and correctness/native-app evidence required before quality generation. This recorded scope is not a test, quality verdict or permission to launch inference.
